Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Quarterly revenue was $1.1 billion, up 10% from the prior-year quarter, as Software subscriptions grew 28%. Hardware revenue declined 4% amid softer demand from distributors in Europe. Gross margin was 47.0%.

Liquidity. Cash and equivalents were $1.2 billion at quarter end. We repurchased $80 million of shares in the quarter and maintained full availability under our $500 million revolving credit facility.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

There have been no material changes to our market risk exposures since our most recent annual report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year, which described our foreign currency and interest rate exposures in detail.

PART II — OTHER INFORMATION

Item 1A. Risk Factors

There have been no material changes to the risk factors disclosed in our annual report, except that recently announced tariffs on imported sensors could increase our component costs and pressure Hardware gross margin.
